placements.title: Governing Knowledge Retention, Deprecation, and Memory Expunction
placements.frame: How does the organization establish, maintain, and enforce policies for decommissioning and expunging historical records, decisions, and system migrations?

placements.title: Purging Obsolete Decisions and Deprecated Technical Records from Organizational Context
placements.frame: How should superseded or abandoned technical decisions and migration records be systematically decommissioned and expunged from institutional memory?
placements.why: Directives instruct the explicit forgetting of a named decision and the complete removal of migration knowledge.
